project_adapter_contract.ADD: call the pinned simulator on the authorized FN mask and encode the returned curve as POSITIVE_FOREGROUND (+1)
project_adapter_contract.REMOVE: call the same pinned simulator on the authorized FP mask and encode the returned curve as NEGATIVE_BACKGROUND (-1)
project_adapter_contract.primary: one curve per episode with a stable patient-hash strategy
project_adapter_contract.robustness: three matched attempts, one strategy and one curve per attempt
project_adapter_contract.provenance: record requested/effective strategy, fallback, polarity, source residual type, seed and raster hash
project_adapter_contract.truth_boundary: The upstream callable supplies geometry only. Operation and polarity are assigned by the project adapter from the frozen FN/FP source; they are never inferred from a hidden target during model execution.

server_policy: Only these three fixed files and the audited project polarity wrapper enter the server execution zone; the full repository, paper notes, official model and weights remain outside the runtime package.
